message:
Running command: cd /tmp; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/hyb python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import pandas.core.common as com
a = com.asarray_tuplesafe([("a","b","c")]); print(type(a), a.dtype, a)
print(type(pd.Index(a)), pd.Index(a))
from pandas.core.indexes.base import ensure_index
print(type(ensure_index([("a","b","c"),("c","d","e")])))
mi = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples([("a", "b"), ("c", "d"), ("b", np.nan)])
import pandas.core.indexes.base as B
orig = B.Index._maybe_downcast_for_indexing
def spy(self, other):
    r = orig(self, other); print("  downcast:", type(other).__name__, other.nlevels, "->", type(r[0]).__name__, type(r[1]).__name__, r[1].nlevels); return r
B.Index._maybe_downcast_for_indexing = spy
s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3], index=mi)
print(s.loc[[("a","b","c")]].tolist())
print(mi.get_indexer([("a","b","c"),("c","d","e")]))
print(mi.get_indexer(pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples([("a","b","c"),("c","d","e")])))
EOF
